hints.title: Functional Graph Structure
hints.text: Every node has out-degree 1. Therefore, each connected component consists of directed cycles with incoming tree branches.

hints.title: Topological Pruning
hints.text: Compute in-degrees and peel away non-cycle tree branches using Kahn's algorithm, tracking order on a stack.

hints.title: Cycle Propagation
hints.text: Nodes left with in-degree > 0 belong to cycles. Traverse each cycle to determine its size S. Then backtrack along tree branches: ans[u] = ans[edges[u]] + 1.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in graph
complexity.notes: Linear topological sort and cycle decomposition.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing paths from each node takes O(n^2), timing out for n = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary arrays for degrees, queue, and answer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose functional graph into cycles and branches in linear time.
